summary: Override the default template location with parser template_path.
questions: How do I use a template from a custom path with cli_parse?

answer_card.title: Set a full template path
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.utils.cli_parse:
    command: show interface
    parser:
      name: ansible.netcommon.native
      template_path: /home/user/templates/filename.yaml
```
